name: Clash
summary: A timed skill check when two fighters meet blow for blow.

sections.heading: The skill check
sections.body: A bar appears with **CLICK & HOLD M1**. While your marker is outside the target zone the bar reads *OFF TARGET*. Each side builds up seconds (for example YOU 0.9 s, OPPONENT 1.0 s); whoever has more when the timer runs out wins.

sections.heading: Level range
sections.body: Clashes happen in PvP and PvE. There is no clash across a level gap of 500 or more.

disputed: Whether a much higher player can still force a clash on a lower one, leaving them no clash defence, is unknown.
